name: GS-W Network Architecture
aliases: Gaussian in the Wild model parameters
definition: Defines the neural network components (Unet, Fusion MLP, Color MLP) and training hyperparameters for the GS-W method.
summary: The GS-W Network Architecture predicts view-dependent Gaussian appearance and visibility by using a U-Net to extract image features and a fusion network to combine them with intrinsic attributes, replacing static colors.
